method: For each gene, z-score cluster mean log-normalized expression across C0-C8; pathway activity is the arithmetic mean of member-gene z-scores.
user_decision: C5 and C8 retained without exclusion
interpretation_boundary: Activities are cluster-level descriptive expression scores, not patient-balanced differential pathway tests. C8 is immune-like and C5 is mixed, so their activity profiles require the existing QC caveat.
